title: Memory Lane
summary:
Vlad's Castle, Romania

The Huntik team searches Vlad Dracul's Castle in order to lay hand on Titans which once belonged to evil Count Vlad, but the team splits and Klaus orders Zhalia to get rid of its members one by one. When all hope seems lost, Zhalia repents for her betrayal, leaving the Organization for good and helping our heroes.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext: Still recovering from [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia's]] betrayal, the team go after the [[Titan]] of [[Sir Lancelot]], [[Cavalier]]. While [[Sophie]] and [[Cherit]] investigate a library for clues about it while [[Lok]] and [[Dante]] start the quest for the Titan. They pass many challenges but somehow feel that they're being helped. When they find the Titan, they find that [[Rassimov]] has been sent to collect the Titan, and the team are horrified at Rassimov's [[Darkvoid]] ability.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.wikitext:
An incredible battle is happening on a stormy mountaintop. Clouds obscure the details, revealing only red lightning and purple energy. A small Titan watches the battle between a strange evil shadow and the silhouette of a man with a glowing amulet. It is Lord Casterwill who is facing an [[Nullifier|evil creature]], uttering the syllables "Sen Ten Gon" before calling Cherit to his side. The little Titan has a moment of bravery and charges toward the great darkness.

The battle scene fades and changes to the present, where Lok is trying to get Cherit’s attention. Guggenheim gives the team a mission to retrieve the lost treasures of Sir Lancelot, which may include a Casterwill item, and may point them to the Amulet of Will!

Over in Prague, Rassimov tells the Professor his Suits have located Lancelot’s mausoleum and that he’ll deal with it personally. Sophie goes to a Huntik Foundation library to research documents and discovers a secret library that only Casterwills can enter! Inside the secret library, she finds a book with a picture of an amulet—an amulet that Cherit somehow recognizes as the Amulet of Will!

Dante and Lok, not knowing that Rassimov is following them, enter Lancelot’s mausoleum and are attacked by ghosts and magical traps. Rassimov secretly helps them because he’s using them to get past the traps. When Dante and Lok reach the treasure room, Rassimov attacks them (they got past all the traps, so he doesn’t need them anymore!). Rassimov summons Lancelot’s Titan Cavalier, but Cavalier resists Rassimov’s evil. Angry at Cavalier’s refusal to help him, Rassimov casts a [[Darkvoid]] spell that consumes all the magic in the room and destroys Cavalier, which should be impossible! Rassimov uses a power to vanish before Dante can attack, but the heroes find a secret room with a new Casterwill power — one that can repair Lok’s father’s journal!

full_text:
Vlad's Castle, Romania

The Huntik team searches Vlad Dracul's Castle in order to lay hand on Titans which once belonged to evil Count Vlad, but the team splits and Klaus orders Zhalia to get rid of its members one by one. When all hope seems lost, Zhalia repents for her betrayal, leaving the Organization for good and helping our heroes.

== Plot ==
Still recovering from Zhalia's betrayal, the team go after the Titan of Sir Lancelot, Cavalier. While Sophie and Cherit investigate a library for clues about it while Lok and Dante start the quest for the Titan. They pass many challenges but somehow feel that they're being helped. When they find the Titan, they find that Rassimov has been sent to collect the Titan, and the team are horrified at Rassimov's Darkvoid ability.

== Summary ==
An incredible battle is happening on a stormy mountaintop. Clouds obscure the details, revealing only red lightning and purple energy. A small Titan watches the battle between a strange evil shadow and the silhouette of a man with a glowing amulet. It is Lord Casterwill who is facing an evil creature, uttering the syllables "Sen Ten Gon" before calling Cherit to his side. The little Titan has a moment of bravery and charges toward the great darkness.

The battle scene fades and changes to the present, where Lok is trying to get Cherit’s attention. Guggenheim gives the team a mission to retrieve the lost treasures of Sir Lancelot, which may include a Casterwill item, and may point them to the Amulet of Will!

Over in Prague, Rassimov tells the Professor his Suits have located Lancelot’s mausoleum and that he’ll deal with it personally. Sophie goes to a Huntik Foundation library to research documents and discovers a secret library that only Casterwills can enter! Inside the secret library, she finds a book with a picture of an amulet—an amulet that Cherit somehow recognizes as the Amulet of Will!

Dante and Lok, not knowing that Rassimov is following them, enter Lancelot’s mausoleum and are attacked by ghosts and magical traps. Rassimov secretly helps them because he’s using them to get past the traps. When Dante and Lok reach the treasure room, Rassimov attacks them (they got past all the traps, so he doesn’t need them anymore!). Rassimov summons Lancelot’s Titan Cavalier, but Cavalier resists Rassimov’s evil. Angry at Cavalier’s refusal to help him, Rassimov casts a Darkvoid spell that consumes all the magic in the room and destroys Cavalier, which should be impossible! Rassimov uses a power to vanish before Dante can attack, but the heroes find a secret room with a new Casterwill power — one that can repair Lok’s father’s journal!
